messages:
jane_auditor: Quick check-in — during the SOC2 fieldwork we need proof for the RBAC change on the inference cluster last Thursday. Specifically: who approved, the change diff, and the audit-log entries showing the role binding modification. Also need any KMS key usage tied to that deployment.

alice_sre: hey — taking this. I can pull the Kubernetes audit and the cloud audit trail. Do you need raw logs or a pre-packaged evidence bundle? :thinking_face:

jane_auditor: Prefer a packaged bundle with a short README that maps each log to the control (CC6/CC7). Raw is ok too as long as it's labelled. A sample correlation line linking the deploy ID to the KMS decrypt would be ideal.

ben_sec: adding context — the RBAC change was a service-account addition (service-role: inference-worker) to the deployment rolebinding. It was done via our CI CD job `deploy/inference:canary` and approved in the onboarding ticket #INF-402.

carla_prodsec: tagging the remediation/vuln side — there was also a low-severity CVE patch rolled the same window. We should include the vuln-triage note and the change log so auditor can see tie-in.

miguel_oncall: I initiated the canary, can confirm approval: I clicked the GitHub PR approval and the Ops-runbook check passed. I can produce the GitHub audit event and the PR diff.

alice_sre: plan: 1) export k8s audit for the inference namespace around 2024-11-14T03:00:00Z +- 30m 2) export cloud audit (CloudTrail) events for IAM/KMS around the same 3) collect the CI job log with deploy ID 20241114-deploy-771 4) generate a README mapping each artifact to SOC2 control IDs.

jane_auditor: good. For KMS we need the key id, the decrypt/Encrypt events, and evidence of rotation policy (when was the key last rotated?). Also any HSM/KMS delegation notes.

ben_sec: KMS key: alias/redwood-inference-prod. Last scheduled rotation: 2024-07-02. We use a short-lived delegated key for inference KV cache encryption — here's the AWS CloudTrail query I used to find decrypts:
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=alias/redwood-inference-prod --start-time 2024-11-14T02:30:00Z --end-time 2024-11-14T04:30:00Z
```

ben_sec: sample CloudTrail entry (anonymized):
```
{ "eventTime": "2024-11-14T03:07:12Z", "eventName": "Decrypt", "userIdentity": {"type":"AssumedRole","arn":"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/inference-runtime-role/miguel"}, "resources": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345" ], "requestParameters": {"ciphertextBlob":"..."} }
```

carla_prodsec: good, that shows the assumed-role mapping. For RBAC change proof, k8s audit will show `Patch` to RoleBinding with `user=miguel` and we should correlate the `authorization.k8s.io/decision` if we have it in the audit output.

alice_sre: example k8s audit snippet (sanitized):
```json
{"stageTimestamp":"2024-11-14T03:06:59Z","verb":"patch","user":{"username":"miguel_oncall","uid":"U-702"},"objectRef":{"resource":"rolebindings","name":"inference-deploy-binding"},"requestObject":{"changes":"+subjects:[{kind:ServiceAccount,name:inference-worker}]"}}
```

jane_auditor: perfect — two things: 1) can you include a cryptographic hash for each exported file in the bundle (sha256) 2) add a short timeline.txt that ties PR# -> CI job -> k8s patch -> cloudtrail decrypt. That linear chain is what our team will check.

miguel_oncall: will do. I'll upload a ZIP to the secure auditor bucket at s3://redwood-audit-drop/2024-11-14/ with checksums. Sharing once done.

ben_sec: note on emergency access: we used an approved short-lived escalation for a quick config fix earlier that day. There is an approval ticket in PagerDuty and the oncall audit entries are included under `pd:incident/IN-887` in the bundle.

carla_prodsec: adding the vuln-triage doc: /drive/sec/vuln-triage/2024/INF-402.md and the change log with CVE references. I'll snapshot that into the bundle.

infra-bot: deploy job finished: 20241114-deploy-771; status: success; artifact: sha256:8a7f...; canary=3/3; rollout=complete.

alice_sre: ETA for packaged bundle — 45 minutes. I'll include: README.md, timeline.txt, k8s-audit.jsonl, cloudtrail-events.jsonl, ci-deploy.log, kms-rotation-policy.pdf, vuln-triage.md, PR-diff.patch, checksums.sha256.

jane_auditor: thanks. One extra ask — please annotate the README with the mapping to SOC2 control sections (change management, least privilege, key management). A one-line mapping per file is fine.

miguel_oncall: uploaded: s3://redwood-audit-drop/2024-11-14/1762509876_bundle.zip (private link shared in DM). Checksums: checksums.sha256 included.

alice_sre: tagged the thread with :white_check_mark: — bundle is in the bucket and I pasted the DM link in the auditor channel. Anything else?

jane_auditor: this should be enough for the initial review. If we need deeper raw event expansion we'll ask — for now the chain and KMS decrypts are the primary controls. appreciate the quick turnaround. :handshake:

ben_sec: logging note for the post-audit action item — add a persistent correlation-id in CI deploy logs (deploy_id) so future cross-system correlations are trivial. Filed: SEC-642.

carla_prodsec: noted. i'll add it to the postmortem/controls backlog.

jane_auditor: thanks everyone — closing this check-in.
